item.title: El sarampión resurge en Estados Unidos: Pensilvania reporta su quinta muerte del año
item.description: Estados Unidos registra más de 3.600 casos confirmados de sarampión, una enfermedad que había declarado eliminada hace 26 años. La caída de la vacunación alimenta los nuevos brotes, mientras existe una disputa entre las autoridades federales y Pensilvania, el estado más afectado, sobre el número de muertes. item.title: In 2023, New York mother arranged a fundraiser to erase strangers' medical bills after her death
item.description: Casey McIntyre's battle with stage four ovarian cancer led her to launch a remarkable campaign aimed at eliminating medical debt. Through her organization, Undue Medical Debt, she managed to relieve over $120 million in healthcare bills, directly benefiting more than 51,000 people. Her initiative stirred local community movements focused on medical debt relief, and fundraising efforts continue to support others facing similar challenges. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Clashes between French teens, police as school blockades intensify
item.description: French teenagers on Tuesday set fire to rubbish bins and threw projectiles at police who responded with batons and tear gas, with hundreds detained across the country over the blockades and protests demanding better conditions at schools. Since last week, students have staged protests outside hundreds of schools over grievances including timetables, class sizes and a shortage of teachers as well as overheated classrooms during this year's heatwaves. FRANCE 24's Rachel Griffiths reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: China will charge an extra 55 per cent tariff on Brazilian beef from Thursday after Brazil filled its import quota for the year and has not agreed to let Brazilian exporters use the unfilled quota of neighbouring Uruguay, industry sources said. The Chinese Ministry of Commerce announced the surtax on Wednesday, a day after China’s customs administration confirmed that Brazil had used all of its 1.106 million-tonne allowance for 2026, and under the rules the extra tariff applies from the third... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Prosecutor reopens probe into Cornell gang rape allegations
item.description: A New York prosecutor has reopened an investigation into gang rape allegations at a Cornell University fraternity in response to a lawsuit filed by a woman who says she was sexually assaulted in 2024 by seven students after being plied with alcohol and drugs. Tompkins County District Attorney Matthew Van Houten said Monday that his office will present evidence to a grand jury as he faces questions from the public about why there were no criminal prosecutions in the case. France 24's Annette Young, host of The 51 %, has more. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: One in eight cancers worldwide linked to infections, WHO agency says
item.description: A new study from the International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC) shows that an estimated 2.3 million new cancer cases worldwide in 2024 – about 12% of all new cancer cases – were caused by infections and could be prevented with treatment or vaccines. FRANCE 24's Jennie Shin speaks with the lead author of the study, Dr Gary Clifford, Scientist at the IARC. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: How does a bird virus infect a person?
item.description: How do we know when an animal virus might pose a risk to humans? Canada confirmed a human case of H5N1 avian influenza (often called "bird flu") in 2024, the first known to have been acquired in Canada. The patient, a 13-year-old from British Columbia, suffered severe symptoms, including respiratory failure, but recovered with intensive care in a hospital. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: 16-year-old turned a childhood art project into a lifeline for children in hospitals
item.description: Dani McTague, who started 'Dani's Dream' at ten, has donated over 3,700 art bags to children in need. Her initiative grew after receiving nationwide donations during the COVID-19 pandemic. McTague has also served as a 4-H Ambassador and led numerous workshops to mentor younger leaders. Recently selected for the Hall of Fame, she received a scholarship for her achievements. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Researcher solves a nanoparticle mystery using an iPhone camera
item.description: Instead of capturing a memory with an iPhone camera, Carnegie Mellon University's Nivedita Shyamsundar used hers to make a scientific discovery. A senior in the Department of Chemistry, Shyamsundar studies tiny particles that could help medicines and vaccines travel more effectively through the human body and reach their targets. Her work may one day lead to better cancer treatments and stronger vaccines. Fuente: Phys.org.
